source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
The errata changes **Vashtorr the Arkifane** as follows:

- New ability, [Indentured Daemon Engines](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.vashtorr-the-arkifane.indentured-daemon-engines): this model has **[Lone Operative](vsdata:core-ability/lone-operative)** while at least 1 **DAEMON VEHICLE** unit of yours is no more than 3" from it.
- [Reorder Reality](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.vashtorr-the-arkifane.reorder-reality): when an enemy unit no more than 18" away targets this model, its attacks get -1 to the **Hit roll** and its ranged weapons gain **[[HAZARDOUS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/hazardous)** until the end of the phase.
- [Unholy Mechanisms](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.vashtorr-the-arkifane.unholy-mechanisms): friendly **DAEMON VEHICLE** units no more than 6" from this model get +2 Strength on their models' weapons.

Both profiles of Vashtorr's hammer are melee, WS 2+, with **[[ANTI-VEHICLE 4+]](vsdata:weapon-ability/anti)** and **[[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/devastating-wounds)**:

- **Vashtorr’s hammer – strike**: 6 attacks, Strength 14, AP -3, Damage 3
- **Vashtorr’s hammer – sweep**: 12 attacks, Strength 8, AP -1, Damage 2
